show.description: One slideshow. doc.title names it. seconds is how long each slide stays up when it plays, 0 to move on by hand; look is its colours and type: warm, night or paper.

slide.description: One slide in a slideshow, in playing order. doc.title is its heading and doc.body its words. photo is the eid of the uploaded picture, served at ./api/blob/<photo>; layout is photo (the words over the picture), side (the picture beside the words) or words (no picture).
